title: This is my ...
objectives: 会用 This is my ... 介绍自己
能听懂并回应别人的介绍

blocks.title: This is my nose
blocks.content: 指着自己的鼻子说：This is my nose. 指着耳朵说：This is my ear. “This is my ...” 就是“这是我的……”。

blocks.title: 两个人一问一答
blocks.content: A: This is my ear. B: This is my ear, too. 你也可以指着别人说 This is your ear.

exercises.stem: 听一听，选出你听到的句子。
exercises.explanation: 听到的是 nose，不是 ear 或 mouth。

exercises.stem: “这是我的耳朵”用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: 耳朵是 ear，套进句型 This is my ...。

exercises.stem: This is my mouth. 说的是哪个部位？
exercises.explanation: mouth 是嘴，用来说话、吃饭。
